Package arcade.patch.agent.process

Class PatchProcessMetabolismRandom

java.lang.Object
arcade.patch.agent.process.PatchProcess
arcade.patch.agent.process.PatchProcessMetabolism
arcade.patch.agent.process.PatchProcessMetabolismRandom
All Implemented Interfaces:
Process
public class PatchProcessMetabolismRandom extends PatchProcessMetabolism
Extension of PatchProcessMetabolism for random metabolism.

PatchProcessMetabolismRandom will uptake a random fraction of glucose and oxygen from the environment. Oxygen is converted to ATP through oxidative phosphorylation and some random fraction of glucose is converted to ATP through glycolysis.

PatchProcessMetabolismRandom will increase cell mass (using random fraction of internal glucose) if cell is dividing and less than double in size.

  • Constructor Details

    • PatchProcessMetabolismRandom

      public PatchProcessMetabolismRandom(PatchCell cell)
      Creates a random metabolism Process for the given PatchCell.

      Module only has internal glucose.

      Loaded parameters include:

      • CELL_VOLUME = cell volume
      • INITIAL_GLUCOSE_CONCENTRATION = initial cell internal glucose concentration
      Parameters:
      cell - the PatchCell the process is associated with
